scope: Bounded cross-frame placement alignment from complete routed boundary fragments. Every accepted trial keeps domain dimensions, box dimensions, vertical bands and dyadic scales unchanged; complete routes are rebuilt and validated before acceptance. Existing/reused frames remain fixed during navigation and repair.

review.findings: Root reviewed integration, persistence/accounting, tests and final source changes. Independent read-only agent review found no actionable correctness defect in shared work accounting, pin/anchor host protection, prior-frame stability, exact routing reuse, cancellation and transactional cache publication.
review.migration: Missing feedback work counters default to zero. Versions 1/2 retain local-only pin interpretation; version 3 uses downward-only inheritance; versions 4/5 use bidirectional region-relative constraints. Older geometry is validated/repaired before writing v5. Public contract, dependencies, quality and composition versions unchanged; private placement cache key includes boundary refinement revision.

controlled_fixture.scope: Deterministic two-frame fixture with fixed distant pin; unchanged box sizes, frame domains, bands and scales asserted. Additional three-frame test checks moved proxy, exact unchanged child interior, complete boundary joins and semantic membership. Cache, pins, tiny budget and pre-cancellation checks are separate cases.

representative_probes.control_scope: Feedback allowance 0 versus 4 affects both flat kernel feedback and the composed pass, and changes shared allocation. These are policy-control development probes, not an isolated causal comparison or calibrated/held-out release evaluation. One sequential pair per case; do not infer latency percentiles. Membership and final geometry independently checked.

native_pins.input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.
native_pins.scope: Actual native composed display and isolated v5 persistence. Exact rendered pinned position checked across collapse/reopen/unpin/undo and parent return; exact canonical point and truncated anchors checked through database/table descent. Child-origin pins preserve their original anchors when displayed in parents, including collapse/reopen, open-origin navigation and undo. Inheritance never copies owned registry entries. Restart and eviction have separate worker/core regressions; this process does not simulate hardware input or establish latency percentiles.
native_pins.image_observation: Orders parent view after child-origin pin undo/return renders ten objects and seven paths. Small nested interiors and occluded labels remain. No comprehension claim.

native_production.input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

surface_summary.scope: CPU scheduling bracket before/after Bevy prepare_windows in the render schedule, including time to schedule either marker and concurrent render work. This is not exclusive function time or GPU time. It covers swapchain acquisition/reconfiguration for all extracted windows; a call may reuse an existing texture. Render invocation numbers are independent of main frame IDs. Correlate by shared-clock start/duration offsets. Markers add ordering constraints/overhead but leave prepare_windows and window settings unchanged.

native_production.measurement_scope: One traced native run without screenshots or OS sampling. Timings cover CPU acceptance, not hardware input or GPU presentation. User previews remained running; no claim of controlled comparative latency.

limitations: Requires an initially valid routed composition; does not repair initially unroutable cross-frame geometry or enlarge passages.
Bounded horizontal terminal alignment is not a global or negotiated multi-commodity optimum. Dense congestion, occlusion and individual frame metrics can worsen under a better total score.
Zero-feedback control also changes flat feedback and initialization allocation. Improvements relative to it cannot be attributed solely to the new pass.
Additional complete routing trials add solve time. No profile calibration or fresh held-out acceptance is claimed.

Native scripts prove viewer actions and persisted geometry, not physical OS input or comprehension. Current production run reproduced a 1,058 ms render handoff overlapping surface acquisition, with last-observed occlusion false; no root cause or remedy proven.
Cached repository collapse was 116.9 ms, above the 100 ms target. Broader scale, performance, topology/group/reference overrides and actual human comprehension gates remain open.
